about: Four rail_access topics, one city each: the Rail Access Monitor's starting cities (docs/enhancements/rail-access-monitor.md §2). Each entry is a complete body for the admin API's POST /topics; docs/deployment-runsheet.md, 'rail_access topics', shows how to create them with scripts/admin_cli.py. Each box sits inside one 100 km UTM square, so inside one Sentinel-2 tile. adapter_config sets only the site and its reach; every other key takes the rail_access adapter's default (docs/enhancements/vision.md §5). Each city's daily cycle runs every day, a minute apart from 09:05 Sydney time (Sydney, Melbourne, Singapore, Boston): the daily cycle drafts only the Findings of its last 24 hours, so a city drafted on fewer days would never have the other days' Findings written; a day with no new Finding drafts nothing. force_manual_review is forced on for this adapter whether or not it is sent.

editorial_goals.primary_focus: Report what the rail access measurements show for Sydney: the share of its built-up area within walking reach of a rail station, the built-up area beyond it, the station count, the scene's capture date and coverage, and the rule-based flags and simulations, as proxies measured from satellite imagery and OpenStreetMap.
editorial_goals.exclusion_criteria: No ridership, timetable, journey time, cost or funding claims; no recommendation to build, extend or close anything; no cause, forecast, political or planning view; no place names or numbers that are not in the findings.
